added_lines: . family carers ireland- mayo’s ballina carer support group meeting takes place from 10 to 11.30am in the green room at the ballina manor hotel, f26 hy84, on thursday november 12th. the group meets on the second thursday of the month. this is a great opportunity to meet local supports manager, michelle moriarty and have a chat with other carers. no need to register, just turn up on the day! mayo cancer support provides free support services to those affected by cancer. call (094) 9038407 . the loudest word ever shouted is probably the word ‘quiet’! straide church rotas for november first reading: deirdre reid. second reading: lily keenan. prayers of the faithful: servers. minister of communion: mary byrne. offertory collectors: paddy & marian mchale. opening/closing church: bridie mulroy. straide
